page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.2xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, delivering 8 vCPUs mapped across 4 dedicated physical cores with symmetric multithreading (2 threads per core). The hardware configuration includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512 (f, vnni, bf16), along with hardware-accelerated cryptographic extensions like AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

The instance delivers 64.0 GB of system RAM, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 8.0 GB of memory per thread. It carries 0 GPUs and provides no bundled local instance storage, requiring remote storage volumes for persistent data. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 4 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-thread capability, with Geekbench single-core reaching 2005.0 and stress-ng single-core scoring 3074.68, both placing in the top 25 percent. Multi-threaded metrics fall largely in the middle 50 percent, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 7753.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 14423.27. Memory testing shows 607.86 GB/sec cached small-block read speeds, but uncached large-block reads drop to 37.19 GB/sec (bottom 25 percent), while large-block writes maintain 27.94 GB/sec.

Application benchmarks show reliable operational throughput, recording 11.05 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 10.13 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. PassMark database operations measure at 3899.19. The high memory density relative to core count provides balanced resource efficiency for memory-intensive enterprise tasks, making the instance well matched for in-memory caching layers, relational database hosting, and memory-bound transactional workloads.
